title: Local Cognition Gear and Sourcing Horizon
objective: Make local cognition resources legible, temporarily leaseable, and pressureable without making model identity, resource availability, selection, lease, invocation, seat identity, or execution authority collapse into one relation.
claim_ceiling: This horizon may only advance bounded model-resource registry, lease, and source-selection distinctions. It does not establish adaptive routing, scheduling, autonomous escalation, or model authority.
pressure_points: Pressure durable resource legibility independently of seat identity or permanent assignment.
Pressure temporary lease exclusivity and release without granting the seat ownership of the model.
Pressure deterministic source selection so model list order cannot silently become routing policy.
completion_criteria: Each retained unresolved relation has explicit adjudicated standing or is superseded by a pressure-earned fracture that makes the relation unnecessary.
No retained result requires permanent seat-model identity or model-owned action authority.
Any future source-selection relation remains explicitly separate from availability, eligibility, lease, and invocation.
stop_conditions: The campaign basis cannot be reconstructed.
A proposed pressure requires automatic execution or authorization.
A proposed pressure silently introduces scheduling or autonomous model escalation.
A proposed selection mechanism cannot make its policy basis explicit.
